summary: A dataset's links now belong to the display it was saved at, so a triangle stored monthly under a yearly view keeps its yearly links live.
details: A link names a cell of the grid that was on screen when it was written, not a cell of the file, so values can be typed and Excel ranges pasted at that view over a file stored finer.
Links are held still only while the length controls sit off the pair the dataset was last loaded or saved at: no contours, no link editing, no refresh, and the save is refused.
The formula bar and the save refusal share one sentence naming the lengths to put back.
